privS1Intro: The data controller responsible for your personal data is:
privS1LegalNote: HSR Games is a community-run project and is not a registered company; for legal purposes it is represented by the organization above.
privS1DpoNote: If a Data Protection Officer (DPO) is appointed, their contact details will be published here.
privS2Intro: We process the following categories of personal data to operate the Service:
privS2_2Item3: Roles held on the HSR Discord server – automatically refreshed every 60 seconds
privS2_3Intro: Our Roblox game server (HSRServer) records the following:
privS2_3Item1: Join and leave events with timestamps
privS2_3Item3: Playtime, distance traveled, XP and level
privS2_4Item1: Active and completed duties (type, start/end time, train assignment)
privS2_4Item2: Weekly duty summaries and compliance status
privS2_4Item5: iOS Live Activity APNs push tokens – stored only during an active duty
privS2_5Item1: Exam attempts and their status (IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, TIMED_OUT, VIOLATION)
privS2_5Item3: Violation logs: browser tab switching and application focus loss events
privS2_6Item1: Submitted support ticket content, messages, and agent assignments
privS2_6Item2: Guest user identifier stored in a cookie (guest-support-id) for anonymous tickets
privS2_7Item1: Web Push VAPID subscription endpoints and public keys
privS2_7Item2: Mobile app Expo push tokens (Android and iOS)
privS2_7Item3: APNs Live Activity push tokens (iOS, linked to an active duty entry)
privS2_8Item1: Full audit trail (e.g. LOGIN, DISCORD_LINK, BANNED, MOBILE_LOGIN, admin operations)
privS2_8Item2: IP and device metadata for session security events
privS2_8Item3: Session identifiers and session security data
privS3Heading: Purposes of Processing and Legal Bases
privS3Intro: We process personal data only where a valid legal basis under Article 6 GDPR applies.
privS3Row1Data: Roblox/Discord ID, OAuth tokens, session data
privS3Row4Data: Duty data, schedule requests, weekly summaries
privS3LegitNote: Where processing is based on legitimate interests, we conduct a balancing test to ensure your fundamental rights are not overridden.
privS4Intro: The Service relies on the following third-party providers:
privS4P4Desc: File storage (R2 object storage), CDN and infrastructure
privS4P6Desc: iOS push notifications and Live Activity
privS5Body: Due to the use of Roblox OAuth and Discord APIs, your data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area (EEA), including to countries without an EU adequacy decision. We apply appropriate safeguards, including:
privS5Item1: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission, where applicable
privS5Item2: Transfer impact assessments and supplementary technical measures as needed
privS5Item3: Data minimization and strict access controls for transferred data
privS6Intro: We send two types of emails:
privS6MandatoryBody: Security alerts, account notices, legal updates, schedule reminders, and weekly duty summaries. These are part of contract performance and cannot be opted out of.
privS6OptionalPre: Newsletters and feature announcements – sent only with your consent. Opt out at any time via the unsubscribe link or by contacting
privS7C1Purpose: JWT session token. Essential for maintaining login state.
privS7TrackingNote: We do not use third-party tracking or analytics cookies. If Google AdSense ads are displayed, Google's own cookie policy applies.
privS8Body: The Service is not intended for children under 16 years of age in the EEA, unless the member state permits a lower digital age of consent (not below 13) and all legal requirements are met. If we learn that data has been collected from a child without the required consent, we will delete it without undue delay.
privS9Intro: We implement technical and organizational measures appropriate to risk, including:
privS9Item1: Encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest for sensitive data
privS9Item2: Role-based access controls and least-privilege administrative access
privS9Item3: Secure handling, rotation, and storage of authentication tokens and secrets
privS9Item4: Full audit logging, anomaly monitoring, and incident response procedures
privS9Item5: Regular updates, patching, and security hardening of infrastructure
privS9Item6: Backups, recovery controls, and data integrity safeguards
privS9bIntro: If a personal data breach occurs, we follow this process:
privS9bItem1: Contain and assess the breach as soon as it is detected
privS9bItem2: Notify the competent supervisory authority within 72 hours where required by law
privS9bItem3: Notify affected users without undue delay if the breach is likely to result in a high risk to their rights
privS9bItem4: Document the breach, its effects, and the remedial action taken
privS9bNote: This process follows Articles 33-34 of the GDPR on the notification of personal data breaches.
privS10Intro: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the relevant purpose:
privS10Item1: Account and profile data: for the duration of the account and up to 30 days after a deletion request, unless longer retention is legally required.
privS10Item2: Authentication and security logs: up to 12 months to investigate abuse and incidents.
privS10Item3: Support and dispute records: up to 24 months after case closure.
privS10Item4: Game, duty, and schedule data: for the duration of the account.
privS10Item5: Exam and training logs: for the duration of the account, or as required by law.
privS10Item6: Consent records (optional emails): up to 3 years after withdrawal.
privS10Item7: Legal compliance records: as required by applicable law.
privS10Note: When retention is no longer necessary, data is deleted or irreversibly anonymized.
privS11Intro: Subject to legal conditions, you have the following rights:
privS11Item1: Right of access – request a copy of your personal data
privS11Item2: Right to rectification – request correction of inaccurate data
privS11Item3: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
privS11Item6: Right to data portability – request your data in machine-readable format
privS11Item7: Right to withdraw consent at any time (where processing is consent-based)
privS11Item8: Right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority (in Hungary: NAIH)
privS11HowPost: . We may request identity verification before completing your request. We respond within 30 days.
privS12Body1: Donations are processed exclusively by Stripe, a PCI DSS-compliant payment processor. HSR does not collect, store, or access full card details (card number, CVV, expiry date).
privS12Body2: We retain the following donation-related data: the amount, the timestamp, the Stripe reference identifier, and the fact of a successful payment. This is used solely to award Supporter status, send confirmation emails, and maintain financial records as required by law.
privS12Body3Pre: Your payment data is never sold, shared, or used for marketing. For details on how Stripe handles your data, see
privS13Body: We update this Privacy Policy when required by legal, technical, or operational changes. For material changes, we notify you via the Service and/or email, and update the "Last updated" date. We recommend reviewing this page periodically.
privS14Intro: For privacy inquiries and GDPR requests, contact us at:
privS14GdprNote: For GDPR requests, use the subject line: "GDPR Request". We respond within 30 days.
trmS1Intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of HSR – Hungarian State Railways Simulation (the "Service"). The Service provider is:
trmS2Body: By creating an account, signing in through Roblox OAuth, or otherwise using the Service, you agree to these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, you must not use the Service.
trmS3Body1: You must be at least 16 years old to use the Service in the EEA, unless your Member State permits a lower digital age of consent (not below 13) and all legal requirements are met.
trmS3Body2: Where parental or guardian consent is required by law, you may use the Service only if such consent has been validly obtained.
trmS4Body1: The primary authentication method is Roblox OAuth 2.0. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activities performed through your account. You must provide accurate information and keep it up to date.
trmS4Body2: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or applicable law.
trmS5Body1: Access to protected Service features (e.g. duty system, exams, schedule, wiki, admin panels) requires linking your Discord account registered on the HSR Discord server.
trmS5Body2: The roles you hold on the HSR Discord server determine which features and permissions you have access to within the platform. Roles are managed exclusively on the Discord server by authorized staff.
trmS6Body1: The platform uses a priority-based permission system (0–100 scale). Higher-priority roles grant broader access. Permissions are mapped to 20 defined flags covering duty, scheduling, supervision, admin functions, and more.
trmS6Body2: In-platform permissions update automatically based on Discord roles (every 60 seconds). Some permissions can be individually overridden by an administrator.
trmS7Item1: Use the Service for unlawful, fraudulent, or abusive activities
trmS7Item2: Attempt unauthorized access to other accounts, systems, or data
trmS7Item3: Interfere with Service availability, security, or integrity
trmS7Item4: Use automated methods to extract or scrape data without permission
trmS7Item5: Impersonate any person or misrepresent your affiliation
trmS7Item6: Deliberately circumvent or manipulate the duty system, exams, training, or schedules
trmS7Item7: Distribute malicious code, spam, or harmful content within the Service
trmS8Intro: Users holding certain roles (e.g. Train Driver, Dispatcher, and related roles) are required to meet a weekly duty minimum.
trmS8Item1: Users who fail to meet the weekly minimum automatically receive a WeeklyDutyStrike.
trmS8Item2: Accumulated strikes may result in loss of privileges or account suspension.
trmS8Item3: Strikes can be contested through the DutyAppeal system.
trmS8Item4: Advance exemptions can be requested (e.g. for holiday or illness) via an administrator.
trmS8Item5: Exemptions (WeeklyDutyExemption) cover specific date ranges and require admin approval.
trmS9Intro: Users with Trainee and related statuses are required to attend scheduled training sessions.
trmS9Item2: Repeated unexcused absences may result in more serious consequences (e.g. suspension or demotion).
trmS9Item3: The training instructor informs participants of expectations and consequences.
trmS10Intro: Exams are conducted under rules set by the administrator. By participating in an exam, you accept the following:
trmS10Item1: Browser tab switching, window switching, and application focus loss are prohibited and automatically recorded (ExamViolation).
trmS10Item2: An administrator may force-stop the exam at any time.
trmS10Item3: Multiple violations may result in exam invalidation (VIOLATION status) and sanctions.
trmS10Item4: Exam results (score, status, answers) are permanently stored and may be used for eligibility decisions.
trmS10Item5: Exam images and uploaded content are stored on Cloudflare R2.
trmS11Body1: The Wiki section can only be edited by users with the MANAGE_WIKI administrator permission. Content published on the platform (articles, images, descriptions) is the intellectual property of HSR Games.
trmS11Body2: Do not upload, publish, or share third-party copyrighted content, personal data, or infringing material.
trmS12Body1: The support ticket system must be used for genuine issues and questions. Abusive, deliberately misleading, or spam submissions may result in account suspension.
trmS12Body2: You agree to receive strictly necessary service notices (e.g. security, account, and legal notifications). Optional communications (e.g. newsletters) are sent only with your consent.
trmS13Intro: The iOS and Android mobile application communicates with the web platform via OAuth 2.0.
trmS13Item1: Mobile access tokens are valid for 7 days; refresh tokens for 90 days.
trmS13Item2: Tokens are stored in the device's secure storage (SecureStore).
trmS13Item3: On a 401 error, the mobile app automatically attempts to refresh the token.
trmS13Item4: The iOS Live Activity feature displays active duty data in real time on the notification surface.
trmS13Item5: App versions (.apk, .ipa) are distributed through Cloudflare R2 storage.
trmS14Intro: We may suspend or terminate your access if:
trmS14Item2: you create a legal or security risk, or
trmS14Item3: you engage in misuse of the Service.
trmS14Body: Where reasonably possible, we will provide notice and an opportunity to remedy the issue. You may stop using the Service at any time and request account deletion under the Privacy Policy.
trmS15Body: Personal data processing is governed by our Privacy Policy. You will find there the purposes and legal bases for processing, your GDPR rights, retention periods, international data transfers, and security safeguards.
trmS16Body: Unless otherwise stated, the Service – including software, branding, and content – is owned by HSR Games or its licensors and protected by applicable intellectual property laws. These Terms grant you a limited, non-exclusive, revocable right to use the Service for its intended purpose.
trmS17Body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Service is provided "as is" and "as available" without express or implied warranties. We do not exclude liability where exclusion is prohibited by law, including liability for fraud, wilful misconduct, or gross negligence.
trmS18Body: We may update these Terms for legal, security, or operational reasons. For material changes, we will provide reasonable advance notice via the Service and/or email. Continued use of the Service after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
trmS19Body1: These Terms are governed by the laws of Hungary, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protections applicable in your country of residence.
trmS19Body2Pre: For disputes, you may first contact us at
trmS19Body2Post: to attempt an informal resolution. You also retain the right to contact a competent court or supervisory authority under applicable law.
trmS20Body1: All donations and support payments made through the platform are voluntary contributions intended to fund server costs, development, and community events. Once a payment is processed and confirmed, it is final and non-refundable.
trmS20Body2: By completing a donation, you acknowledge and agree that:
trmS20Item1: (a) the payment is a voluntary contribution, not a purchase of goods or services;
trmS20Item2: (b) no refunds, chargebacks, or reversals will be issued except as required by applicable law;
trmS20Item3: (c) if you believe an error has occurred, you must contact us within 48 hours of the transaction via support.
trmS20Item4: (d) Supporter perks are granted at our discretion and may be modified or withdrawn at any time without entitling you to a refund.
trmS20Body3: Google AdSense ads may be displayed to users who have not reached Supporter status. These ads are used solely to fund platform operation and development costs.

emailSupervisionFailedBody: Unfortunately, your most recent supervised run did not count towards the 4 supervised runs required to complete training.

emailSupervisionFailedContact: If you have any questions, contact an administrator.
emailSupervisionPromotionIntro: Congratulations! You have successfully completed all 4 required supervised runs. You are now a fully qualified train driver and can drive trains on the server!
emailSupervisionPromotionDutyBody: As a train driver, you must complete a minimum of 4 hours of duty per week. This ensures you remain active in the organisation.
emailSupervisionPromotionWarningBody: If you do not meet the weekly 4-hour minimum, you will receive a warning. Warnings do not result in immediate removal, but they must be cleared.
emailSupervisionPromotionClearNote: Clearing a warning: To clear a warning, you must meet the weekly 4-hour requirement for 2 consecutive weeks after receiving it.
emailSupervisionPromotionRiskNote: Warning: If warnings accumulate without being cleared, it will lead to removal from the organisation.
emailSupervisionPromotionOutro:
Good luck and welcome to the team!
HSR Team
emailSupervisionDispatcherReadyBody: You have successfully completed all 4 supervised duties. Congratulations!
emailSupervisionDispatcherReadyNext: On the dispatcher track the role is granted manually by the leadership, so do not start solo duty yet – they have been notified and will get back to you.
emailInstructorQuotaWarningIntro: Your instructor activity last week fell short of the requirement.
emailInstructorQuotaWarningNotice: This is your first warning. If you miss the quota again next week, your Instructor role may be removed.
emailInstructorQuotaWarningRule: The weekly requirement is 2 trainees taken fully through their path, that is 8 sessions in total. Every session you run counts as 0.25 of a trainee, whether the trainee passed or not. The requirement never exceeds the work that existed: a week with no trainees to teach counts as met automatically.
emailInstructorQuotaWarningInactiveNote: If you are on leave, the requirement is reduced in proportion to those days – the leave has to be booked in advance, it does not count retroactively.
emailInstructorTerminationTitle: Your Instructor role has been removed
emailInstructorTerminationIntro: You repeatedly missed the weekly instructor quota ({week}), so your Instructor role has been removed.
emailInstructorTerminationRoleNote: Your other roles are unaffected – only the instructor permission was withdrawn.
emailInstructorTerminationAppealNote: If you believe this is a mistake, raise it with the leadership in a support ticket.
emailInstructorTerminationRevokedSubject: Your Instructor role has been restored
emailInstructorTerminationRevokedTitle: You got your Instructor role back
emailInstructorTerminationRevokedIntro: The removal of your Instructor role was reviewed and revoked, so the role has been granted back on Discord.
emailInstructorTerminationRevokedRoleNot: Your weekly instructor quota counts again, starting from a clean slate.

botAppealPolicyDesc:
You can appeal here, and how many times depends on what you're appealing:

• **Termination** — up to **3** appeals in total
• **Warnings** — up to **5** appeals in total
• **Missed duty** — **no limit**, appeal every one of them

Tell me which one you'd like to appeal and I'll take your case to the team.
botAppealNeedReasonDesc: Write your reasoning in **one message** — what happened, and why you think the decision should be changed. I'll pass it to the team exactly as you write it, and they decide.

supervisionRulesSubtitle: This is what the supervisor evaluates against. The list always shows the version currently in force.

supervisionRulesWarningLaps: No fault points may be issued in the first {laps} lap(s) — the supervisor warns you about anything spotted there.
supervisionRulesPointsFromFirstLap: Fault points may be issued from the first lap.
supervisionRulesThreshold: Collecting {points} fault points is a fail.
supervisionRulesInstantFailWarned: Instant-fail acts fail the supervision in any lap; in the warning laps the first such case is a warning, but a repeat is a fail.
supervisionRulesInstantFailAlways: Instant-fail acts fail the supervision immediately, in any lap.
supervisionRulesDocumentationDuty: After every lap the supervisor must document what they saw, and must brief you on how fault points are issued.
supervisionRulesLoadError: The rulebook could not be loaded.
botDutyBreakErrMissing: ❌ Provide a user and a duration of at least 1 day.
botDutyErrTargetNotLinked: ❌ This user has no linked HSR account.
botDutyErrAdminNotLinked: ❌ This command requires a linked HSR account.
botDutyBreakGrantedDesc: **{user}** has been exempted from the duty requirement for **{days}** day(s), starting today.
botDutyBookingsPrompt: Pick a booking from the list below to remove it.
botDutyRemoveConfirmIntro: Are you sure you want to remove **{user}**'s booking?
botDutyRemoveComponentError: ❌ An error occurred while handling the booking.
inspectorServicesHint: The services your rank is qualified for. Booking one makes you the inspector on both the outbound and the return train; you start your duty from the booking.
inspectorNoServices: There is no service for your rank on this day.
inspectorNoTodayBooking: You have no booking for today. Book a service above, or start your duty without one.
examApplicationBlockedTitle: You cannot apply at the moment
examApplicationBlockedBlacklisted: Your account is excluded from applications. If you believe this is a mistake, please open a support ticket.
examApplicationBlockedBanned: Your account is banned, so you cannot submit an application.
examApplicationBlockedEnrolled: You are already in the {program} programme, so you cannot fill in this application form.
emailClosingExamRuleVoice: You do not need to join a Discord voice channel during the exam.
emailClosingExamRuleWindow: The exam slot stays open for 1 hour — you can start it any time within that window, then finish it at your own pace.
emailClosingExamRuleAutoGrade: The exam is graded automatically, and you will receive the result by email.
emailClosingExamRuleNoShow: If you register for a slot but never start the exam, you are automatically marked absent and your training deadline is shortened by 7 days.
emailTrainingPassSupervisionIntro: You can now request supervised sessions (supervision) in the {program} programme.
emailTrainingPassSupervisionRequired: You need {count} successful supervisions to be promoted.
emailTrainingPassSupervisionRules: You can find the exact rules and the fault-point system on your dashboard, under Supervision rules.
emailTrainingPassSupervisionTicketHint: Request a supervision by opening a support ticket in the "Supervision / Felügyelés" category.
emailTrainingFailNextSteps: An instructor will be in touch with you soon about the next steps.
emailExamSlotConfirmationBody: You have successfully registered for the closing exam time slot: {date}.
emailExamSlotConfirmationCancelInstructi: If you can no longer attend, you can cancel your registration using the button below.
emailExamSlotNoShowSubject: HSR – You missed your closing exam
emailExamSlotNoShowBody: You registered for a time slot of the {exam} exam, but never started it during the open window.
emailExamSlotNoShowPenalty: Because of this, your training deadline has been shortened by {days} days.
emailExamSlotNoShowNote: You can register for another upcoming slot before your deadline runs out.
examSlotCancelInvalidDesc: This cancellation link is invalid or has already been used.
examSlotCancelTooLate: This slot has already closed and can no longer be cancelled.
examSlotCancelSuccessDesc: You have successfully cancelled your registration for this exam slot.
badgesSubtitle: The badges you have earned, and the ones you are close to.
profilePrivateBody: Its owner chose not to share it.
profileEditSubtitle: This is how the rest of the railway sees you.
profileHandleHint: This becomes your profile's address. 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. Left empty, your id keeps working.
profileAccentHint: A colour too dark to read is lifted automatically, so the page stays legible.
profileBannerHint: Up to 5MB, JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF. With no image, the chosen preset is shown.
profileBannerFramingHint: Choose which part of the picture shows in the strip. Press Save to keep it.
profileBannerTooLarge: That image is too large (5MB maximum).
profileBannerType: That image format is not supported.
profileFavoriteHint: Type anything — picking from the list below puts the locomotive's photo on your profile too.
profileBadgePinHint: Up to three badges sit next to your name.
profileSpotifyHint: Link it and your profile shows what you are listening to; your yearly summary gets a music chapter too.
profileSpotifyFailed: The connection failed. Please try again.
profileSpotifyNotAllowed: Your Spotify account is not approved for this app yet. Ask an admin — they need to add you in Spotify's developer dashboard, or get the app approved.
profileSpotifyUnavailable: Spotify linking is not available right now.
profileVisibilityPUBLICHint: Your profile opens from a link, with or without an account.
profileVisibilityMEMBERSHint: Only signed-in HSR members can see it.
profileVisibilityPRIVATEHint: Nobody but you, and the staff who manage members.
profileHandleFormat: A handle is 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.
badgesAllEarned: You have earned every badge. Nicely done!
praiseOnceHint: You can praise each colleague once.
praiseErrorWINDOW_CLOSED: This shift can no longer be used to praise anybody.
praiseErrorNOT_A_COLLEAGUE: You were not on duty with this colleague.
praiseErrorLIMIT_REACHED: You have used every point for this shift.
praiseErrorINVALID: Something was wrong with that request.
wrappedIntro: We gathered what happened to you on the railway in {year}. Here is your year.
wrappedHighlightBusiestMonth: Your busiest month was {month}, with {count} duties.
wrappedHighlightStation: You most often started from {station} ({count} times).
wrappedHighlightTrain: Your most frequent train was {train} ({count} times).
wrappedPraiseBody: You received {received} praises from colleagues and gave {given}.
wrappedMusicNote: From Spotify's long-term listening history — roughly the past year.
wrappedMusicUnlinked: Connect Spotify on your profile and next year your music will be here too.
wrappedFunEarth: Your kilometres would circle the Earth {laps}×.
wrappedFunFilms: In your time on duty you could have watched {count} feature films.
wrappedAllTimeBody: Level {level}, {xp} XP, {distance} km and {hours} hours in game all told.
wrappedAllTimeRank: That puts you at #{rank} on the leaderboard.
wrappedFooter: You are getting this because you were active with us this year.
